NOTE
**Still not ready — screenshots don't yet follow the visual-changes guide**

New: The author posted two screenshots in a comment and says the description is updated, with no new push. Missing: The description still reads "Screenshots to be added by author in comments", and the screenshots aren't labeled as before/after at different screen sizes, which the issue asks for.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to put labeled before/after screenshots in the PR description; PR #40052 also touches the same file for this issue, so a maintainer may want to check how the two relate.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for adding screenshots! Please put precise before/after screenshots at a few different screen sizes in the PR description itself, following the [guide on presenting visual changes](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html), and remove the "to be added" placeholder.
```
